brief.subject: FTC sues to stop $3.5 billion vet supply merger
brief.headline: FTC Moves to Block $3.5 Billion Vet Supply Deal Over Pet Care Costs
brief.dek: Regulators say merging the two largest veterinary distributors could push up prices for clinics and pet owners.
brief.lede: The FTC has sued to block Covetrus from buying rival MWI Veterinary Supply for $3.5 billion. The agency warns the deal could raise what pet owners pay.

sections.heading: FTC Targets Vet Supply Merger
bullets: The FTC filed suit to stop Covetrus from acquiring MWI Veterinary Supply for $3.5 billion.
The two firms are the biggest distributors of veterinary products and services, according to the FTC.
Regulators allege the combination would raise costs for vet clinics, which could reach pet owners' bills.
Covetrus owners Clayton, Dubilier & Rice and TPG are also named in the suit.

sections.heading: Store Cards: Read the Fit
